description: This Java class `SavingsTransactionsWorkbookPopulator` is responsible for populating an Excel workbook with savings transaction data, including setup of data validation rules, default formulas, and sheet layout. It references various other population classes to generate a comprehensive import template for savings transactions within the Apache Fineract platform.

classes.name: SavingsTransactionsWorkbookPopulator
classes.description: A class to generate and populate an Excel workbook for bulk import of savings transactions, setting up sheet layout, data validation rules, defaults, and references to other supporting sheets.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Creates the savings transaction sheet, sets layout, populates data, sets validation rules, defaults, and text styles.

methods.name: setDefaults
methods.description: Populates a range of rows with formulas to fetch product and balance info based on account numbers.

methods.name: setTextFormatStyle
methods.description: Applies text formatting to specified columns to ensure they are treated as strings.

methods.name: setRules
methods.description: Sets data validation rules for various columns such as office, client, account number, transaction type, payment type, and date.

methods.name: setNames
methods.description: Defines named ranges for offices, clients, accounts, and payment types for use in data validation formulas.

methods.name: populateSavingsTable
methods.description: Fills the sheet with savings account data, including client name, account number, product, optional minimum balance, and activation date.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Initializes the sheet layout, including setting column widths, headers, and styles.
